name: Angel Heart
source:
She is a righteous heroine who fights to stop the sinister ambitions of "Deep Throat" who disturbs the world order. She has a strong sense of justice. 

She is a good-looking and pure hearted young virgin girl who is not good at talking down to others.
　
By holding the transformation ring "Infinity Angel Ring to her heart to transform.

[Translation from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/sentou/]Official Site[/url]]
